pages.rules:
Carefully study this section of the rules; by following them, you have nothing to fear.

 

Fight Club is not just a game, it's your path to self-improvement and freedom. Every member of the club goes through trials. You must not only win fights but also find your own purpose, build communities, and help other members on their journey.

 

The first rule of Fight Club:

Tell everyone about Fight Club. Fight Club is not a game, it's your path to freedom. Share this freedom with others.

 

The second rule of Fight Club:

Find meaning. Fight Club has a purpose, and every player must achieve it to become part of the club.

 

The third rule of Fight Club:

Be honest with your own. Anyone who tries to deceive the club will be banned forever.

 

The fourth rule of Fight Club:

If you have something to say — say it. Any advice and help are welcome. Your activity is valued by the club.

 

The fifth rule of Fight Club:

You can quit at any moment. There is a 'Delete Account' button in the 'Profile/Settings' section.

 

 

The main rules reflect the core principles: share, achieve your goals, be honest, speak up, and don't give up.

 

Share freedom:

When you become part of Fight Club, you take on the responsibility of its development. Tell others about the club, invite friends, share your experience. Fight Club is not a solitary path, but a brotherhood united by a common goal.

 

Find your purpose:

Each member of the club should strive for their personal goal. It could be winning fights, building the strongest club, or finding yourself through participation. Once you've achieved your goal, you become not just a fighter but a full-fledged member of Fight Club.

 

Honesty is everything:

There is no place for deceit or lies here. Fight Club exists thanks to trust. Any attempt to deceive other members or the club will result in immediate expulsion. Honesty is the foundation of relationships between fighters.

 

Activity creates value:

Don’t be afraid to speak up, share your opinions, and help others. Your activity within the club is essential for its growth. Advice, ideas, suggestions — these are the things that make the club stronger. If you see how the community can be improved, don’t stay silent — your voice matters.

 

It’s your choice:

You can leave at any moment. It’s important to understand that participation in Fight Club is a choice. If you feel that your mission is complete or you no longer want to participate, you always have the option to delete your account in the settings.

 

Attention: Pre-launch Restrictions

 

Maximum purchase:

During the pre-launch phase, each participant can purchase tokens for no more than 5,000 USD, regardless of the current token price. The starting price of the token is 0.1 USD and will gradually increase. Two months before listing, it will reach 0.5 USD.

Example: If you buy tokens at the beginning of the pre-launch phase at 0.1 USD per token, you can purchase up to 50,000 tokens for 5,000 USD. If the price rises to 0.5 USD per token, the maximum purchase will still remain 5,000 USD, but the number of tokens you can buy will decrease to 10,000.

 

Important: This limit does not apply to in-game activities, such as hitting the punching bag and participating in fights. You can earn tokens there without any limit on the amount.

 

Thus, regardless of the current token price during the pre-launch phase, the maximum purchase amount remains capped at 5,000 USD until listing.

 

Minimum purchase:

The minimum amount for token purchases during the pre-launch phase is 5 USD.

 

Training and its limitations:

Training time: Training sessions are limited to a certain number of hits, calculated individually for each player. Factors such as balance, activity, completed tasks, and other in-game metrics are taken into account.

Training earnings: Depending on the level of the punching bag, you will earn between 2 cents and 20 cents for each hit.

 

For detailed information, check out the help section
